Juniper YM-2651D / YM-2651DAR AC Power Supply – Compatible with MX80, MX5, MX10, MX40 Routers

Product Overview:

The Juniper YM-2651D and YM-2651DAR AC power supplies are high-efficiency, hot-swappable power modules engineered for Juniper MX Series routers, specifically MX80, MX5, MX10, and MX40. Designed to meet the demands of enterprise networking environments, this 500W power supply ensures reliable, uninterrupted operation for mission-critical infrastructure.

Key Features:

  • Model Numbers: YM-2651D / YM-2651DAR
  • Power Output: 500 Watts
  • Input Voltage: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz
  • Form Factor: Internal, hot-swappable
  • Connector Type: Standard IEC C14 input
  • Cooling: Integrated cooling fan for heat dissipation
  • Efficiency: Energy-efficient design to reduce power consumption
  • Compatibility: Fully compatible with Juniper MX80, MX5, MX10, and MX40 routers
  • Compliance: RoHS and industry safety certifications

Why Choose the Juniper YM-2651DAR Power Supply?

Reliable Uptime: Ensure continuous router operation with a redundant, hot-swappable design.

Enterprise-Grade Build: Built for performance in data centers, ISPs, and corporate networks.

Cost-Effective Replacement: Ideal as a replacement or spare for failed power units in MX Series routers.
